summary: AngloGold Ashanti filed a Form 6-K enclosing its Q3 2026 earnings release for the three and nine months ended 30 September 2026, a routine foreign-private-issuer results announcement. Q3 EBITDA rose 12% to $1,568m on a $4,239/oz realized gold price, free cash flow was $722m, net cash reached $1,256m and the board declared a 71 cps ($361m) interim dividend, bringing YTD declarations to 259 cps. Full-year guidance was reaffirmed. No transaction, ownership change or solicitation is disclosed; the filing is an operational and financial update only.
